title: Scaled Dot-Product Attention
description: Implement scaled dot-product attention: softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d_k)) V.

test_cases.code:
import numpy as np
np.random.seed(42)
Q = np.random.randn(4, 8)
K = np.random.randn(4, 8)
V = np.random.randn(4, 8)
_out, _w = attention(Q, K, V)
assert _out.shape == (4, 8), 'output shape must be (4, 8)'
assert _w.shape == (4, 4), 'weights shape must be (4, 4)'
assert np.allclose(_w.sum(axis=-1), 1.0, atol=1e-6), 'each weight row must sum to 1'
_scaled = (Q @ K.T) / np.sqrt(8)
_e = np.exp(_scaled - np.max(_scaled, axis=-1, keepdims=True))
_ref_w = _e / _e.sum(axis=-1, keepdims=True)
assert np.allclose(_w, _ref_w, atol=1e-6), 'attention weights are incorrect (did you scale by sqrt(d_k)?)'
assert np.allclose(_out, _ref_w @ V, atol=1e-6), 'output must be weights @ V'
print('ALL TESTS PASSED')
